name: pt-hoss
goal: photo_tools (image_convert) wave 1: Hoss authors dither.rs (S), svg.rs (M). First Rust campaigns: measure which scope suits each member. S small, M exact/byte-exact, L largest algorithm, C crate-facing with the API card.

tasks.instructions: i32 buffer, never clamped; each share is err * k / 16 with Rust's truncating division; every row left to right. Walk the 3x3 example step by step. Write the module once, in one reply; do not restate the contract.
tasks.test_instructions: Include the truncation row [200, 152], the no-clamp row [100, 255, 115] and the row-order row [128, 128, 100, 100].

tasks.instructions: Byte-exact. fmt_num works on the rounded integer r = (v * 100).round() as i64 - never format a float and trim. Copy the document template character for character, including every \n. Write the module once, in one reply; do not restate the contract.
tasks.test_instructions: Compare whole strings. Cover every fmt_num row, an empty loop in path_data, and a shape with an empty d in document.
